entries.text: I like you too, Cam.

entries.text: Doesn't it feel like these arms could go around the world?
entries.translation: 不觉得好像伸出手臂就能拥抱全世界吗

entries.text: I think I strained something.
entries.translation: 我想我背部好像扭伤了

entries.text: I always wanted a daughter-
entries.translation: 我一直想要个女儿

entries.text: to dress her up in pretty dresses,
entries.translation: 给她穿漂亮的小裙子

entries.text: do her hair, her nails, her makeup.
entries.translation: 给她做头发 美甲 化妆

entries.text: No one knows this, but for the first year of his life,
entries.translation: 透露个小秘密 曼尼一岁的时候

entries.text: I made up Manny like a girl
entries.translation: 我把他打扮得跟个女孩似的

entries.text: and told everybody that he was my daughter.
entries.translation: 逢人就说他是我女儿

entries.text: Ay, but just for a few times.
entries.translation: 不过也就那么几次

entries.text: I didn't want to mess with his head.
entries.translation: 我可不想让他对自己的性别产生困惑

entries.text: When he found the pictures,
entries.translation: 当他看到他小时候的照片

entries.text: I told him that it was his twin sister who died.
entries.translation: 我告诉他那是他已经死了的双胞胎姐姐
